article.title: In this West Bank village, Israel won’t let Palestinians visit their dead
article.author: Shatha Hammad
article.content: Since August, Israeli settlers have blocked Palestinians from Umm Safa from reaching the village's only cemetery. Residents say it's the latest in a series of escalations by settlers — backed by the Israeli army — who are trying to expel them.
